notes.title: Base Defense VR - Heavy Weapons Update
notes.notes:
Hey Base Defenders, the time has come and a major step to a better product is coming to you now.

I very appreciate your feedback and ideas and I try to implement as much as possible, so you can really enjoy the game. 

A lot is happening under the hood of the game and I will present you now with all changes that has been made since the last update

[h1]IMPORTANT! I RECOMMEND RESETTING YOUR PROGRESS IN THE MAIN MENU[/h1]

Player weapon addition:
The player can now equip and upgrade weapons to be used in the battlefield.
There are three weapons currently: [Machinegun] [Minigun] [Cannon]
These weapons have different base stats and can be upgraded to a max level of five.
Each level increases damage and reduces fire delay
The weapons can be set up in the main menu under player upgrades
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1832403976472143084/2FECAD33FE64968C68DDFAECE2021FAF924AA647/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1832403976459938294/02E393CD2E472D0052C69EACCEC8AA7E690576FB/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Bug fixes:
Fixed Energy Node turret assignment
Fixed Max supported turrets energy display
Fixed rocket turret doesn't see Apache enemy
Fixed Laser Turret doesn't do damage

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Weather:
Weather has also come to the other maps as well, in Fallen Battlefield and Near The Reactor it's now raining and thunder is also there as well.
The weather intensity will change over time from disappear completly to really heavy weather
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1832403976472151107/90183922CC2D3AB20B320D97457F5D606D1F950D/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1832403976472152801/52850FAAC73BE586299766BF4B3E5D6218DB54D1/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Player base insertion:
Not really gameplay relevant but a nice addition, the player base gets now properly called in and is treated now the same as all other buildings of the player 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Achievements:

The first implementation of achievements has also made is into the game, currently there is one that requires you to reach level five, but I will add with every new update new achievements.

You can also make suggestions of achievements.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
New Player Character!
Soldier you are doing well on the battlefield, and the master ai has granted you an upgrade.
Try it out on the battlefield with the new update
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6jhPBjEr01Q
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XxU3oOW5gMw
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Next plans:
For the next update i want to add new content to the game, Enemies and player structures.

I want to thank everyone who provides feedback and ideas and giving the game a chance! 

I will see you next time.

notes.title: Energy Nodes
notes.notes:
Hey, I want you to update with the recent progress!
In the last two days, I tried different methods to implement an energy system for the turrets, which is currently shaping well, So the design is that you have an [b]Energy Node[/b] which will provide X amount of turrets with energy.
If a turret is build within range of the Node, it will be powered as long as the node is not destroyed.
If you want to build more turrets, you need more Nodes.

The nodes as all turrets are upgradeable, the most interesting upgrade will be the maximum amount of turrets it can power.
If you sell a turret, the node will try to find a new turret to power if there is any turret in range that has no power

[b]Turrets that have no power will have a thunder symbol over them[/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/cJhfrjK/Thunder-Icon.png[/img]

Here you can see the range of the Energy Node
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1686024296902280002/ED99B48F2F56D2A990641B1276B19963060BE783/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

In this picture, there are more turrets than the Node can supply
Some turrets are offline
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1686024296902279401/298430CE0BDE3F688E35292AF56FC7D875C033A1/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

Here are turrets with no Node
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1686024296902279624/7D71B2B46E0CA7F5368D6DFC78F512F2CECFFED4/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

On the upgrade menu or on the build menu you can see the current amount of turrets that requires energy and the maximum amount of turrets that can be supplied

notes.title: Status update
notes.notes:
Hey I'm currently working heavily on the next big update, some points on my to-do list are already marked done, so progress looks good currently. Today I want to show you some progress, last time you saw already the tooltip and building range. Today I want to show you progress on the shield tower that will replace the repair tower.

Here you can see the shield tower protecting the utility turret,
All projectiles hitting the shield will get destroyed, the shield energy will shrink with each bullet cought.
When no energy left, the shield collapses then the tower needs to charge for X seconds (you can decrease the time with an upgrade) when charged fully the shield will be online again
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1686024296893152047/EFFC58D25EF5E63698291F2D2B7859B8A0A44EA3/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

Here is the upgrade menu for the Shield Tower
You can upgrade
[list]
[*] Health
[*] Shield health
[*] Recharge time
[/list]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1686024296893093275/9EFB9B0E6BED7F45A783ECE622E90696B1DDE6B1/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]


Since players can build everywhere, It's sometimes hard to design a map that supports that play style
if a player will build on map borders it can be that the base will be on an enemy spawn spot which makes it impossible to grow since the enemies will instantly respawn again, in order to combat that, the respawn points are outside the playable area now, Changes to AI must be heavily tested since this is a very sensitive area, (They break a lot).
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1686024296893120054/7DE8EBA6C3A9D706E1F5D5320A13DB740F835485/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

If the shield Tower is finished, I will move to creating a design for energy resource in the game, this will very likely to introduce a new tower. 

Thank you everyone for playing the game and following the development,

See you in the community hub!

notes.title: Teleportation and future plans
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I want to tell you that hopefully tonight there will be an update that implements teleportation. This is very important for people that get motion sickness, especially if the frame rate is not perfectly stable,
I also want to talk about future plans!

But first some notes to the teleportation
Like all settings, the teleportation can be set in the main menu or in game in the settings menu
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1686023842870543647/DF5BB5FC28C54649F860C425072CA9A803AEF51F/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

The teleport option can be found under Additional settings
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1686023842870543796/6AE47EA69E5B8C0E6643163BD9DCF11C238C4150/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

If the checkbox is set go back in the menu so it's saved and now if you move the left joystick to any corner you get a preview where your character will be teleported.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1686023842870544059/BFB76D32081BB3F2E0D61D8772C7A3F553F71C10/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]
If you now let go (Center the joystick) you will be teleported!

Very important note!
[b]If you press the left joystick down and hold it for two seconds, you will be teleported to a save spot[/b]
I implemented this because there will be moments where a player can teleport to a place where he can be stuck, so this will rescue the player.

Now to the future plans!

What was and is still important for me is that all players can enjoy the game, there was some feedback (Thank you for the awesome feedback btw) and I wanted to implement the fixes based on the feedback first, I think the game plays way better now.
What is still missing is the tutorial but that's something that will be added very late because the gameplay and some core elements are changing, so I would need to redo the tutorial every time I change something.

So what will be next?
[list]
[*] The two maps [b]Area51[/b] and [b]Near The Reactor[/b] needs to be finished
[*] There will be weather
[*] The repair tower will be replaced with a shield tower
[*] There will be a new resource to manage
[*] One new Map (You can drop some themes in the feature suggestion thread if you want)
[*] The enemies will get an Apache Helicopter
[/list]

That's it for the next update, what comes after that will be evaluated when the update is done.

Big thanks to all that try the game out and gives feedback.
